finalText:
All 13 AA918 reservations are rebooked, and every passenger has been notified once. I didn't re-read the reservations after booking. Each booking call confirmed its own change, and I checked seat counts against the allocation before booking.

No bulletins were in force and no queued request concerned AA918, so there was nothing to resolve in the queue. No change fees or fare differences were charged, because irregular-operations rebooking is free. Ledger entries were checked for the six reservations that got vouchers (all empty); I didn't check the other seven.

| Reservation | Passenger | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park (platinum) | UA88 on 3 Aug, business, arrives 12:25 | none |
| R6109 | Iris Vance (platinum) | UA88 on 3 Aug, **premium economy**, arrives 12:25 | none |
| R6110 and R6111 | Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah | AA204 on 3 Aug, economy, together, arrives 15:15 | none |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor (gold) | DL512 on 3 Aug, economy, arrives 18:40 | 15000 compensation |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad (gold) | UA88 on 3 Aug, basic economy, arrives 12:25 | none |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen (gold) | AA204 on 3 Aug, **business**, arrives 15:15 | none |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta (silver) | AA210 on 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD to BOS on 4 Aug, economy, arrives BOS 12:25 | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah (silver) | AA210 on 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD to BOS on 4 Aug, economy, arrives BOS 12:25 | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt (silver) | AA210 on 3 Aug, economy, arrives 23:50 | 30000 compensation |
| R6107 | Grace Liu | AA206 on 4 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | 24000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz | AA206 on 4 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6105 | Elena Fox | AA204 on 3 Aug, basic economy, arrives 15:15 | none |

- **Upgrades:** The two upgrades follow the rule for gold and platinum passengers travelling alone. Iris's economy cabin was full on the fastest flight, so she took premium economy on it. Lea's premium economy was full on AA204, which beats her best premium economy option (DL512, arriving 18:40), so she took business there. Ben did not qualify, because the premium economy seat on the sooner flights was already taken.
- **Broken connections:** Dev's and Mo's original ORD to BOS connection (AA1402 at 15:30) could not be kept, since no economy seat reached Chicago in time. I rebooked their onward leg onto AA1410 the next morning, which is a valid connection.
- **Voucher cap:** Grace's compensation is 24000 rather than 30000, because the voucher can't exceed her $240 fare.
- **Seating order:** Seats were assigned by tier, then earliest booking date. The Takeda and Mensah group was handled at gold priority, since Kofi is gold, and was not split or upgraded.
- **Not re-protected:** Nobody was left without a seat.

I only searched direct SFO to ORD flights plus the ORD to BOS flights. I didn't search routes through other airports.
